senses.gloss: examination, assessment. אגרת ב׳ a public announcement inviting buyers to examine the property assessed, i.e. an announcement of public sale = אַכְרָזָה.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Ketubot 11:5">Keth. XI, 5</cite> (<cite ref="Ketubot 99b:17">99ᵇ</cite>); a. fr.—V. <cite ref="A00364"><he>אִגֶּרֶת</he></cite>.

Kerith. 11ᵃ (ref. to Lev. XIX, 20) ב׳ תהיה מלמד שהיא לוקה there shall be bikkoreth, this teaches that she shall be lashed. ומיניין דהדין ב׳ לישנא וכ׳ how do we know that this bikkoreth has the sense of chastisement? Answ. תהא בקריאה … Rashi (ed. בקראי) she shall have the Bible verses read to her (as customary when chastising in court, v.

<cite ref="Mishnah Makkot 3:14">Macc. III, 14</cite>); oth. homilet. interpret. <he>בביקור תהא</he>, v. <cite ref="B00693">preced.</cite> [<cite ref="Tosefta Moed Kattan 2:11">Tosef. M. Kat. II, 11</cite> <cite ref="B00694"><he>ביקורת</he></cite> ed. Zuck., v. <cite ref="B01144"><he>בַּקְרוּת</he></cite>.]
